payout_quote: Get a $100 Mastercard Reward Card for each friend or family member who completes an available referral offer and meets the criteria. You can earn up to $500 per calendar year.
steps: Be a PrimeWay Federal Credit Union member; complete the referral registration form (or call 888-626-3882) to create your referral profile
Enter your friend's name and email address
Friend opens a new PrimeWay personal checking account and within 60 days: receives direct deposits totaling $500+ and makes 5+ debit card transactions (excluding ATMs)
You receive a $100 Mastercard Reward Card (friend also gets $100)
catches: Cap: up to $500 per calendar year in referral rewards (5 x $100)
Reward is a Mastercard Reward Card, not cash deposited to your account
Friend must complete $500+ in direct deposits and 5 debit transactions within 60 days of account opening
Must register for the referral program yourself before referring
biggest_catch: Your friend must funnel $500 of direct deposits and 5 debit purchases through their new account within 60 days — and your reward is a Mastercard reward card, not cash.
eligibility: PrimeWay FCU members; referred friends/family open a new PrimeWay personal checking account
timing: Friend qualifies within 60 days of account opening
